items.description: Indulge in the luscious layers of crispy, sweet kunafa pastry, filled with ooey-gooey cheese and soaked in fragrant syrup. This Middle Eastern delight is a decadent treat that will leave your taste buds craving for more with every bite. Savor the harmonious combination of crunchy, creamy, and syrupy textures in every mouthful of this delectable dessert.

items.name: Three Milk Cake Slice
items.description: Indulge in the decadent delight of our Three Milk Cake Slice - a velvety, moist sponge cake soaked in a trio of creamy milks, topped with a luscious layer of whipped cream. Every bite is a heavenly harmony of sweetness and richness that will leave your taste buds begging for more. Treat yourself to a slice of pure culinary bliss!

items.name: Kunafa Three Milk Cake
items.description: Indulge in the exquisite delight of Kunafa Three Milk Cake - a heavenly dessert crafted with layers of delicate pastry soaked in a trio of rich, creamy milks, infused with a touch of fragrant spices. Each luxurious bite offers a symphony of sweet and velvety flavors that will transport your taste buds to paradise. Savor the divine combination of crisp, golden exterior and luscious, melt-in-your-mouth interior in every glorious bite of this decadent treat.

Served hot with a dollop of butter, every spoonful is a savory delight that will leave you craving for more.
